name: two handed hang back stretch (with training wall bars)
description: Hanging from wall bars with both hands lets gravity stretch your lats and decompress your back. Great after heavy pulling days.
instructions: Grip a wall bar overhead with both hands and walk your feet out slightly.
Let your body hang and sink your hips back, relaxing your upper back and shoulders.
Keep your shoulders relaxed and your breathing slow and steady.
Release gently and repeat, switching sides if the stretch is one-sided.
